{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|'''Identity:''' later revealed to be [[Ozmanthus Arelius]], the ancient Soulsmith he once was.}}

''See also: [[Eithan Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Eithan Arelius family{{!}}Arelius is a highly skilled and eccentric [[Underlord]] belonging to the prominent [[Arelius family]] within the [[Blackflame Empire]]. Known for his striking appearance, including long yellow hair and a frequent, cheery smile, he often presents himself as an idle or even childish figure. However, this persona masks a formidable combatant and strategist with immense [[spiritual perception]]. He possesses a unique bloodline legacy that allows him to perceive his surroundings through physical senses rather than standard [[spiritual perception]], a capability he describes as having thousands of eyes and ten thousand ears. Eithan serves the [[Blackflame Empire]] and has acted as an advisor to the Tiberian Arelius{{!}}Monarch Tiberian Arelius. He is a central figure in many significant events, often appearing unannounced and acting with a sense of Authority{{!}}authority that can rival kings. He has taken Lindon{{!}}Wei Shi Lindon and [[Yerin]] under his protection, acting as a mentor and training them in the [[sacred arts]]. Throughout his life, he has navigated complex political landscapes, occasionally defying imperial Authority{{!}}authority and engaging in high-stakes conflicts. His true nature and ultimate destiny are subjects of much speculation, with some referring to him as the [[Reaper of Worlds]] or a prominent figure among the [[Abidan]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Eithan is a blond, [[yellow-haired man]] who typically wears expensive white shadesilk or various colorful robes in shades of teal, gold, lavender, pink, and blue. In battle, he has been seen wearing [[Skysworn armor]] or sleek black armor from the neck down. As Ozriel, his hair becomes pure white.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Eithan is a high-standard teacher and mentor who has adopted [[Lindon]] and [[Yerin]]. He is an ambitious individual who believes the strong write the rules, though he has abandoned his role as a celestial executioner to attempt raising up others. He is known for being a genius [[Soulsmith]] and a prominent figure in the [[Abidan]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|A [[sacred artist]] and Overlord, Eithan utilizes various techniques including the [[Hollow King's Crown]], [[Empty Palm]], [[Striker]], and [[Ruler]]. He employs [[Enforcer]] binding{{!}}bindings to launch himself and uses [[soulfire]] to reinforce [[constructs]] or heal others. His powers include a detection web, the ability to manifest [[Forged]] stars, and the capacity to tear metal with his bare hands.}}

== History ==
=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|Blackflame City}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|Eithan is a blond man dressed in expensive white shadesilk imported from the west, who utilizes webs of his power to gather information and employs an [[Enforcer technique]] to drift slowly toward the ground.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c6">''Soulsmith'', chapter 6</ref> Utilizing a power inherited from his father's line, he uses an [[Enforcer binding]] to launch himself.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c9">''Soulsmith'', chapter 9</ref> After consuming a liquid that tastes like distilled [[poison]], he refers to [[Lindon]] as 'elder brother' and claims the ability to see the present.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c13">''Soulsmith'', chapter 13</ref><ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c14">''Soulsmith'', chapter 14</ref> Wearing white-and-blue robes, Eithan possesses a superior awareness and the 'thousand eyes' required to know everything within range of his [[spirit]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c14" /> His clan organizes street sweepers in [[Blackflame City]], and while he looks for promising recruits, he demonstrates the strength to tear metal with his bare hands.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c14" /><ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c15">''Soulsmith'', chapter 15</ref> He can approach without being felt due to a collar's effect and uses wrought Iron{{!}}iron fabric scissors as a weapon.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c15" /> The [[yellow-haired man]] has helped [[Lindon]], noting that the latter's throat was not as far gone as he had thought after a breathing [[technique]] nearly killed him.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c16">''Soulsmith'', chapter 16</ref> Eithan Arelius family{{!}}Arelius is a [[sacred artist]] and the heir to the [[Arelius family]], serving as an [[Underlord]] for the [[Blackflame Empire]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c18">''Soulsmith'', chapter 18</ref><ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c19">''Soulsmith'', chapter 19</ref>}}

weeks.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c1">''Blackflame'', chapter 1</ref> After taking [[Lindon]] in, Eithan can be seen wearing a teal outer robe embroidered with golden fish.<ref crisis.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c3">''Blackflame'', chapter 3</ref><ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c5">''Blackflame'', chapter 5</ref> He instructed [[Lindon]] to brush up on his [[Soulsmithing]] and bring his second core up to [[Iron]].<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c5" /> Eithan allowed [[Lindon]] and Fisher Gesha{{!}}Gesha to examine the [[constructs]] and [[scripts]] of [[ring]] while practicing the [[technique]] and demonstrated that he can fill all four crystals in seconds.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c6" /> As an [[Underlord]], his word was able to convince families to permit the marriage of Naru Cassias Arelius{{!}}Cassias and [[Jing]].<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c7">''Blackflame'', chapter 7</ref> Known for having high standards, he is considered [[Paths]], it is noted that Eithan is [[Lindon]]'s adopted brother.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c9">''Blackflame'', chapter 9</ref><ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c10">''Blackflame'', chapter 10</ref> He spent the majority of his childhood in [[Blackflame City]] and is a friend of [[Orthos]].<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c10" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|Skysworn Shores}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|Eithan Arelius family{{!}}Arelius is a figure whose handwriting was discovered in the Deepwalker Ape's prison, and he masks his power by wrapping his core in a [[veil]].<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c1">''Skysworn'', chapter 1</ref> The narrator has felt rage toward him, and he is often seen with a tiny blue [[spirit]] resting on his head.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c2">''Skysworn'', chapter 2</ref><ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c3">''Skysworn'', chapter 3</ref> He once painted a picture of an ancient [[stone]] building atop a tall, lonely mountain with a flat summit.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c3" /> Despite his strength, he informed [[Lindon]] that he lacks a [[Goldsign]].<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c4">''Skysworn'', chapter 4</ref> While using black scissors, he became the primary target of the [[Skysworn Underlord]]'s [[technique]].<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c5">''Skysworn'', chapter 5</ref> In [[Lindon]]'s Spiritual sight{{!}}spiritual sight, Eithan appeared as a sun of green Wind aura{{!}}wind aura and released a pulse of [[pure madra]] from his chest.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c5" /> As the second-ranked [[Underlord]] on these shores, he used [[pure madra]] from his fist to strike [[Naru Gwei]] in the chest.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c5" /> He emits a wave of mostly blue-white and colorless [[madra]], and he has been seen entering rooms holding a pure white knife.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c6">''Skysworn'', chapter 6</ref><ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c7">''Skysworn'', chapter 7</ref> Eithan noted that the timing of certain events is dependent on whether a [[Dreadgod]] arrives to kill everyone.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c7" /> While located below the house, he was wounded in his shoulder by a red hook and utilized a [[Striker technique]].<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c8">''Skysworn'', chapter 8</ref><ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c9">''Skysworn'', chapter 9</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|Eithan's name offers a degree of protection to [[Lindon]], who recently expressed gratitude for the [[Heaven and Earth Purification Wheel]].<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c2">''Ghostwater'', chapter 2</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c8">''Ghostwater'', chapter 8</ref> Having toyed with an idea for several weeks, Eithan is the sole individual to inquire about [[Renfei]]'s death and intends to address [[Redmoon Hall]].<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c4">''Ghostwater'', chapter 4</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c6">''Ghostwater'', chapter 6</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c7">''Ghostwater'', chapter 7</ref> After discussing tiger-chasing, Eithan guided [[Lindon]] to the [[Bloodforged Iron body]] while warning him that others might attempt to kill him to extract his [[cycling technique]] from his [[Remnant]].<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c8" /><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c9">''Ghostwater'', chapter 9</ref> Eithan Arelius family{{!}}Arelius, who uses [[soulfire]] to reinforce [[constructs]] and carries a blue umbrella of waxed fabric that he employs as a weapon, is acting on behalf of the Emperor of the [[Blackflame Empire]].<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c14">''Ghostwater'', chapter 14</ref> Though he remarks that everything ends, Eithan remains a person [[Yerin]] cannot catch up to and is expected at the Emperor's audience hall.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c14" /><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c17">''Ghostwater'', chapter 17</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c19">''Ghostwater'', chapter 19</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|Skysworn missions}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|Eithan is a skilled user of veil{{!}}veils who possesses a [[disciple]] described as a young [[Blackflame]] contracted to a sacred turtle.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c4">''Underlord'', chapter 4</ref> After reaching out to lay a hand on [[Bai Rou]], he explains that [[Skysworn]] require an assignment to finish squad registration.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c4" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c5">''Underlord'', chapter 5</ref> He offers the choice between training to reach [[Underlord]] or undertaking secret missions for The Empire{{!}}the Empire, utilizing a [[Thousand-Mile Cloud]] and a [[void key]] to manage his items.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c5" /> Having been ousted as Jai Patriarch{{!}}Patriarch of the [[Akura clan]]'s [[Blackflame]] branch, he uses a [[scripted fire-starter]] to light his pipe while teaching [[Lindon]] techniques in his [[Skysworn armor]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c4" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c5" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c6">''Underlord'', chapter 6</ref> As [[Lindon]]'s master, Eithan follows a sixteen-step plan for perfecting him as a [[Gold]] and leads him to unclaimed natural treasure deposits.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c8">''Underlord'', chapter 8</ref><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c9">''Underlord'', chapter 9</ref> He notes to [[Lindon]] and [[Yerin]] that a lack of [[soulfire]] causes many potential Underlord{{!}}Underlords to fail their true [[revelation]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c9" /> Serving either the Emperor or the [[Arelius family]], he is duty-bound to a scouting mission for the [[Skysworn]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c9" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c11">''Underlord'', chapter 11</ref> While present during a conversation between [[Lindon]] and [[Yerin]], the two apprentices of Eithan Arelius family{{!}}Arelius are noted.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c12">''Underlord'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c13">''Underlord'', chapter 13</ref> Eithan leads [[Lindon]] through a massive camp outside the city walls to [[Fisher Gesha]], interacting with both [[Lindon]] and [[Dross]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c14">''Underlord'', chapter 14</ref> He intends to rob the Emperor's vaults and is expected to return with the [[Arelius technique library]], making him someone [[Lindon]] fears losing.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c14" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c15">''Underlord'', chapter 15</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|Eithan is a competitor in the Uncrowned King Tournament{{!}}Uncrowned King tournament who advised [[Lindon]] to keep his [[Jade cycling technique]] secret.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c2">''Uncrowned'', chapter 2</ref> Possessing cores like deep lakes and a lifeline resembling a thousand-year [[ancestral tree]], Eithan Arelius family{{!}}Arelius achieved perfect scores on every mental test.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c2" /> While wearing an intricate red ensemble patterned with gold stars, he faced [[Yerin]] as her opponent in the [[Skysworn practice arena]].<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c2" /> After sensing [[Dross]]'s presence, it became clear that Eithan is a person in the city capable of challenging [[Yerin]] or [[Naru Saeya]].<ref back into [[aura]].<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c4" /><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c8">''Uncrowned'', chapter 8</ref> The [[Blackflame team]] member is currently ranked sixty-fourth in the === {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Blackflame Empire competitions}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Eithan, a member of the [[Arelius family]] and [[Lindon]]'s teacher, was found lounging in a padded chair in [[Lindon]]'s room.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c3">''Wintersteel'', chapter 3</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c15">''Wintersteel'', chapter 15</ref> Having spent much of his life in the [[Blackflame Empire]], he prepared for a fight the following morning as part of a competition.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c3" /> While wearing gray fighting robes, the teacher informed his students that he would not hold back during combat.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c4">''Wintersteel'', chapter 4</ref> He utilizes the [[Empty Palm]] and [[Hollow King's Crown]] techniques, carries a stopwatch device, and previously lived under the protection of [[Malice]] and [[Northstrider]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c4" /> After [[Naru Saeya]] suggested that [[Lindon]] and Eithan might join her if they could slip away, Eithan insisted that [[Lindon]] and [[Yerin]] meet at a restaurant.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c5">''Wintersteel'', chapter 5</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c6">''Wintersteel'', chapter 6</ref> [[Lindon]] did not see Eithan at any matches throughout the week, though watching him fight prompted [[Lindon]] to consider the direction of his own [[pure madra]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c6" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c7">''Wintersteel'', chapter 7</ref> During a ceremony, Eithan wore bright ocean-shaded robes.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c7" /> Eithan eventually gathered with [[Yerin]] and [[Mercy]] at the end of the [[cloudship]] dock after watching [[Lindon]] and [[Yerin]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c8">''Wintersteel'', chapter 8</ref> With temporary access to the [[technique library]], Eithan used [[soulfire]] to refine and strengthen himself during an [[advancement]] to Overlord that was less dramatic than his leap to [[Underlord]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c8" /> As an Overlord who is one who sees, he provided perception training to [[Yerin]] but noted that he does not yet see [[Sage]] potential in her.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c8" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c15" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Journey into darkness}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Eithan, an [[Archlord]], traveled with [[Lindon]], [[Mercy]], and [[Fury]] into a [[pillar of darkness]] using one of the world's fastest cloudships.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c18">''Wintersteel'', chapter 18</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c27">''Wintersteel'', chapter 27</ref> During the journey, he spoke to [[Lindon]] about how others perceive him and may have extended his [[pure madra]] to cover the vessel.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c18" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c19">''Wintersteel'', chapter 19</ref> He demonstrated various abilities, such as drifting down on Wind aura{{!}}wind aura, waving people aboard his ship, and utilizing pressure as a focused weapon.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c19" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c23">''Wintersteel'', chapter 23</ref> While he had previously given [[Yerin]] [[dream tablets]], his own safety was now dependent on her victory.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c21">''Wintersteel'', chapter 21</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c22">''Wintersteel'', chapter 22</ref> After [[Lindon]] awoke to find Eithan at his bedside, the [[Archlord]] questioned the ethics regarding whether a copy of [[Yerin]] remains herself.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c25">''Wintersteel'', chapter 25</ref> Mentioned in connection to the plans of [[Malice]], Eithan dove and rolled toward the group before launching a [[Hollow King]]'s Spear.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c26">''Wintersteel'', chapter 26</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c27" /> He fought against Blood aura{{!}}blood aura using [[soulfire]] and [[madra]], even employing the [[Hollow King]]'s Mantle to deflect a flying hawk of [[blood]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c27" /> Following the combat, Eithan was found on the [[cloudship]] dock with [[Lindon]], lying on the floor and breathing raggedly while bleeding.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c28">''Wintersteel'', chapter 28</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">19</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|[[Eithan]] travels with [[Lindon]], [[Mercy]], and [[Fury]] into a [[pillar of darkness]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c18" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|[[Eithan]] has a [[cloudship]] that is one of the fastest in the world.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c18" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|[[Eithan]] spoke to [[Lindon]] about seeing himself as others saw him.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c18" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|[[Eithan]] may have extended his [[pure madra]] to cover the [[cloudship]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c19" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|[[Eithan]] can drift down on a flow of Wind aura{{!}}wind aura.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c19" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|[[Eithan]] is able to wave people aboard a [[cloudship]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c19" />}}</li>

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|The Labyrinth}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Eithan believes that labyrinth{{!}}the labyrinth's function has been intentionally modified.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c9">''Reaper'', chapter 9</ref> Walking into labyrinth{{!}}the labyrinth with an arm around [[Lindon]], he carries a marble containing darkness.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c10">''Reaper'', chapter 10</ref> Despite being a genius [[Soulsmith]], he is vulnerable to [[Enforcer techniques]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c11">''Reaper'', chapter 11</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c12">''Reaper'', chapter 12</ref> While examining the darkness, he indicates that a chamber serves as a passage.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c12" /><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c13">''Reaper'', chapter 13</ref> He uses concentrated [[Striker techniques]] to eradicate [[hunger madra]] strands.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c14">''Reaper'', chapter 14</ref> Dressed in fine pink-and-blue silks, he utilizes the [[Hollow Spear]] and can drop stars of [[pure madra]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c16">''Reaper'', chapter 16</ref> Eithan can blast a trident from the air and project the [[Hollow Spear]] [[technique]] from his scissors.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c16" /><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c17">''Reaper'', chapter 17</ref> During a fight with [[Reigan Shen]], his armor began dissolving and he nearly formed [[Icons]] that would have made him a [[Sage]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c17" /> He is waiting for the [[Joy Icon]] because he does not wish to manifest the same [[Icons]] as Ozmanthus Arelius{{!}}Ozmanthus.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c17" /> While pacing a hallway, he theorizes that labyrinth{{!}}the labyrinth cannot lock them in and calls back regarding an opening exit.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c19">''Reaper'', chapter 19</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|The Origin Shroud}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|While walking with [[Yerin]], Eithan remains restricted by an oath and is capable of moving at [[Archlord]] speed.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c23">''Reaper'', chapter 23</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c24">''Reaper'', chapter 24</ref> He witnessed a Shadow{{!}}shadow of himself ascending to the rank of [[Monarch]] and revealed that he has been holding a black marble.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c25">''Reaper'', chapter 25</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c26">''Reaper'', chapter 26</ref> Possessing the power of the [[Reaper]] and the vision of The Hound{{!}}the Hound, he was once declared the heir of Spider of the Abidan{{!}}the Spider.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c26" /> Although his strength has faded from staying under the [[Origin Shroud]] for a long time, he is known by the full name Tiberian Arelius{{!}}Ozmanthus Tiberian Mereithan Arelius, though his mother called him Eithan.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c26" /> Once known as Ozriel, he used the palm of his hand to stop a cosmic attack.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c26" /><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c27">''Reaper'', chapter 27</ref> As a member of the [[Abidan]], Eithan Arelius family{{!}}Arelius was seen in a vision within his marble and was identified by [[Malice]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c27" /> His cosmic role was to put down worlds that were too sick to continue, but he abandoned this mission to try and raise up people who could replace him.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c27" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Labyrinth}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Eithan is currently navigating labyrinth{{!}}the labyrinth alongside [[Lindon]], carrying the pride, sadness, and anger once held by Ozmanthus Arelius{{!}}Ozmanthus.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c2">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 2</ref> Despite his body being [[blood]]-caked, bruised, and broken, he previously allowed [[Yan Shoumei]] to depart from [[Sky's Edge]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c3">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 3</ref> Holding a title associated with divine skill, he has engaged in combat with a man who blotted out the stars.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c4">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 4</ref> As [[Mercy]]'s superior within the [[Abidan]], he intends to present her with the [[Silent King]]'s bow, though he has expressed dissatisfaction regarding the materials [[Lindon]] used for his own bow.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c6">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 6</ref> While he possesses the ability to resolve such material issues in seconds, Eithan now goes by the name Ozriel and is characterized by his pure white hair.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c6" /><ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 7</ref> Clad in sleek black armor from the neck down, he believes a victory for [[Lindon]] would result in the [[Vroshir]]'s withdrawal, yet [[Gadrael]]'s actions prevent [[Lindon]] from reaching him.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7" /> Having remodeled the interior of The Grave{{!}}the Grave with [[Lindon]], Eithan claims to be the greatest craftsman in all the worlds and possesses the ability to travel through Way{{!}}the Way by tearing open a [[sapphire]] hole in reality.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c12">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 12</ref> His [[fragment]] was a featureless glob consisting of microscopic life, [[water]], and earth, leading him to advise [[Lindon]] to let Way{{!}}the Way manage the remainder of the creation process.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c12" />}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Eithan]] complained about the lack of materials [[Lindon]] used for his bow.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c6" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Eithan]] could resolve the problem in seconds.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c6" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Eithan]]'s hair is pure white instead of blond.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Eithan]] wears sleek, black armor from the neck down.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Eithan]] is now Ozriel.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Gadrael]]'s actions prevent [[Lindon]] from reaching [[Eithan]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Eithan]] believes a victory by [[Lindon]] would cause the [[Vroshir]] to withdraw.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Eithan]] has white hair.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Eithan]] remodeled the interior of The Grave{{!}}the Grave with [[Lindon]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c12" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Eithan]] claims to be the greatest craftsman in all the worlds.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c12" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Eithan]] can tear open a [[sapphire]] hole in reality to travel through Way{{!}}the Way.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c12" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Eithan]]'s [[fragment]] was a featureless glob containing [[water]], earth, and microscopic life.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c12" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Eithan]] advised [[Lindon]] to let Way{{!}}the Way handle the rest of the creation process.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c12" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Eithan{{!}}Eithan Arelius's name ends in '-iel'.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c14">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 14</ref>}}</li>
